mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.inventory_id, b.material_id, b.material_name, b.material_code, b.shelf_id, b.shelf_name, a.quantity, a.associated_no, b.batch, b.case_no, b.unit FROM wms_delivery_receipt_info a LEFT JOIN wms_inventory b ON b.id = a.inventory_id WHERE a.delivery_receipt_id = #{id} and a.del_flag = 0

SELECT IF( HOUR ( a.affirm_time ) >= 8, DATE_FORMAT( a.affirm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ), DATE_SUB( DATE_FORMAT( a.affirm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) AS valid_time, b.quantity FROM wms_delivery_receipt a LEFT JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info b ON a.id = b.delivery_receipt_id where a.del_flag = 0 and b.del_flag = 0 AND a.`status` = 1 AND a.type = #{typeId} AND b.material_id = #{materialId} AND a.affirm_time >= #{startTime} AND a.affirm_time < #{endTime}

SELECT a.id, a.inventory_id, b.material_id, b.material_name, b.material_code, b.shelf_id, b.shelf_name, a.quantity, a.associated_no, b.batch, b.case_no, b.unit FROM wms_delivery_receipt_info a LEFT JOIN wms_inventory b ON b.id = a.inventory_id WHERE a.delivery_receipt_id = #{dto.id} and a.del_flag = 0
SELECT warehouse_id as field1, shelf_id as field2 FROM wms_inventory WHERE id = #{infoId} LIMIT 1
